title: workforce-cc catalog index
description: Schema for catalogs/<source>/index.json — declares every catalog entry with provenance.

license.description: Upstream license. Must be redistributable (MIT, Apache-2.0, CC0, BSD).

upstream_commit.description: Git SHA of the upstream commit this catalog was synced from. Null until first sync.

synced_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of last successful sync.

id.description: Stable identifier; must be unique within the catalog. Use dot-namespacing (e.g. 'ecc.security-reviewer').

source_path.description: Path within bodies/ where the entry's markdown body lives.

upstream_path.description: Path of this entry in the upstream repo, for provenance.

upstream_sha.description: Content hash from the upstream commit. Drift detection compares this against current upstream.

summary.description: One-line description, used in catalog_query.py search results.

tags.description: Free-form taxonomy. Conventions: stack tags (`stack:python-fastapi`), domain tags (`domain:security`), kind tags (`role:reviewer`).

stacks.description: Stacks this entry is recommended for. Empty array = applicable to any stack.
